channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Government must “move from good intentions to a clear long-term plan” for cycling, campaigners warn, as £626 million active travel investment announced
item.description: British Cycling and Cycling UK are among the signatories calling for "predictable cycles and transparent reporting" of infrastructure investment

item.title: “These bikes get hammered, and they have the scars to prove it”: Tern's cargo fleet hits million-mile milestone in New York, claiming its bikes can match vans for delivery speed and volume
item.description: Research into the effectiveness of Tern’s cargo bikes in the Big Apple point to big cost savings with no effect on efficiency compared to vans, plus environmental benefits such as better traffic flow on busy city streets

item.title: MotoGP World Champion has custom Pinarello stolen by thief dressed as team mechanic
item.description: The customised €20,000 Dogma F was stolen during the Valencia Grand Prix weekend, but Spanish Police returned the bike and have arrested a suspect

item.title: Factor officially unveils all-new One aero bike, declaring it “the fastest UCI-legal road bike in the world”
item.description: The radical aero bike was first spotted winning a Dauphiné stage under Jake Stewart. With its huge bayonet fork, ‘chin’ fairing and V-shaped cockpit, Factor says it’s “22% faster than the Specialized Tarmac SL8”. Prices start at £10,899 for a full bike

item.title: “Great! So much more dangerous for pedestrians”: New segregated cycle lane brings internet outrage; Boris Bike Scheme secured for five more years + more on the live blog
item.description: Megan Huws is back to try to brighten up this very grey Thursday with all of today’s cycling news and views

item.title: Q36.5 Dottore Hybrid Bib Tights
item.description: Luxuriously warm, ultra-comfortable, and flawlessly engineered, the Q36.5 Dottore Hybrid Bib Tights set the standard for premium winter cycling performance. 9/10

item.title: Sir Chris Hoy suffers “worst crash I’ve ever had” – but hopes to recover from “smashed up” leg in time to watch the darts
item.description: The six-time Olympic champion, who revealed last year that he has been diagnosed with terminal prostate cancer, broke his leg while riding his mountain bike and is currently on crutches

item.title: 900 cyclists caught drunk cycling banned from driving cars in Japan, as authorities say offenders “likely to pose a significant danger when driving”
item.description: The clampdown on cycling while drunk in Japan comes after stricter laws were introduced concerning phone and alcohol use by cyclists, with more measures, including a ban on holding an umbrella on a bike, set to come into force next year

item.title: Vittoria Terreno T80 tyres
item.description: Durable and grippy tyre that suits winter months, but slow rolling 7/10

item.title: “The path to nowhere”: Ministry of Defence accused of “pettiness” for blocking completion of new cycling and walking route to school – and threatening to fence off 15-metre section if children use it in “nonsensical” row
item.description: The government department claims the shared-use path could have a “detrimental impact” on local families, though the MOD’s decision to reopen discussions with Fife Council has been hailed as a “return to commonsense”
